title: The Signal Tower
blurb: Light the old signal lamps so the last train can come home. Do not move when the Hush looks at you.

title: Pip's Star Jar
blurb: Catch falling wishes with Pip the star-fox before they break. Never tap the red ones. Then wake the big sleepy comet before he falls on you.

title: The Whale Below
blurb: Sink into the dark sea in a little glass bell. A whale the size of a ship is lost because her lights went out. Turn to her song, hold your light on her, and when your lamp dies, hold still while she looks at you.
vr_hook: 1) Not a flat game: you turn your body toward a whale song that comes from the side, behind and below you, and feel a 40 m whale pass right over your glass bell. 2) Body action: turn to the sound, hold your gaze, look up, look down, and finally hold completely still. 3) Whoa (0-15 s): a song behind you, then a whale the size of a ship glides a few meters over your head. 4) Reaction: Bix the lantern fish follows your eyes and wiggles when you look at him; in total darkness Oona's giant eye appears right behind you, leans in while you are still and drifts back if you move. 5) Tomorrow: a whale eye bigger than you at the glass, then her whole body lighting up the sea.
ad_lines: In the dark, something is looking at you.
She carries you to the sunrise.

title: The Moss Giants
blurb: A ring of mossy stone giants stands around you in a moonlit forest. They only move when you don't look. Keep them away from Nib the lantern spirit until sunrise, then look up into the eyes of Gran Mossa.
vr_hook: 1) Not a flat game: the danger is always where you are NOT looking - behind you and at your sides - so you spin your whole body to the grinding-stone sound. 2) Body action: look around, turn behind you, then look up and hold your gaze. 3) Whoa (0-15 s): stone steps behind you; you turn and a 3 m mossy giant is bent down right in front of your face, eyes glowing. 4) Reaction: every giant faces you, freezes the moment you look and is in a new silly pose when you look back; Nib wiggles when you look at him; Gran Mossa leans down and reaches for you only while you look away, and smiles when you hold her gaze. 5) Tomorrow: turning around into a huge stone face, and looking up at a giant as tall as the trees while the sun rises.
ad_lines: They only move when you don't look.
Hold her gaze until the sun comes up.
